k-eigenvalue acceleration requirements (SCDSA/SMM single groupset, SMM P0, stored psi, and vacuum/reflecting boundaries, AAH sweep count, acceleration built for another problem, NLKE DSA single groupset, CMFD and SCDSA-pwlc rejected in 1D spherical, invalid reactor-lattice overlays, and mixed-material aggregation on a non-aggregation mesh) raise ValueError on every rank at Initialize(); neighboring valid configurations, including CMFD in RZ, SCDSA-pwld in 1D spherical, and a 2-by-2 reactor lattice, are accepted

Repeated PI solves with SCDSA, SMM, and CMFD: a second Execute() reproduces k (SCDSA with AAH and l_max_its=2 is accepted again), SetXSMap() between solves rebuilds the acceleration (k matches a new problem and solver), and CMFD leaves the within-group solve settings unchanged
SCDSA with PWLD and PWLC diffusion on a heterogeneous 2D two-group core must reproduce the unaccelerated k-eigenvalue

CMFD (identity coarse mesh, one sweep per power iteration) on a 220 cm reflected 2D core with a high dominance ratio: k must match the unaccelerated k_tol=1e-12 reference, and the power iterations must not grow with the dominance ratio (76 with a converged coarse eigenproblem; 296 when the coarse power iteration stops on k alone)

Unaccelerated power iteration on a slowly converging 1D two-group core must meet k_tol (1e-6 and 1e-8) against a Newton-Krylov reference, checked as error / k_tol. With k_tol = 1e-3, the fission-source test alone must bound the RMS error of the normalized fuel-cell fission sources by fission_source_tol (1e-5 and 1e-7), while the eigenvalue test alone leaves an error far above that
